description_ko: 정원 인형의 꽃 유리보존함과 원예 가위를 이어받은 태엽 사마귀형. 굵은 네 다리와 전면의 하나로 연결된 가위팔이 몸체의 실루엣을 바꾼다.

references.role: Original Flora Gear identity/motif/material reference: gardener cap, swept ivory curls, glass blue-flower core, teal apron and pruning scissors; no anatomy or pose lock
Previous hard Flora opened shell, back winding drum/teal spring construction and clean rendering; redesigned beyond slender doll anatomy
Magnitude of hard-boss silhouette/anatomy change and ivory/brass cel rendering only; gargoyle head/wings/armor not copied

visual_qa.identity: Deep-teal gardener cap, short carved ivory curls, angular doll face, chest glass chamber with one blue flower and green stem, teal apron-like leaf shell, warm brass and original pruning-scissor blade family retained.
visual_qa.hard_transformation: Broad forward-leaning thorax over four thick planted articulated legs. Exactly two armored upper arms become one large pruning-shear mechanism with a single clear brass pivot in front. Original slender two-legged caretaker silhouette changed into a formidable garden predator.
visual_qa.mechanics: Two scissor blades join the same front pivot, with both arm linkages readable; no second loose scissors. Large brass back winch and two curled teal spring strips are attached behind the head/shoulders. Four flared chest petal plates frame the intact flower chamber.
visual_qa.anatomy_and_frame: One head, two upper arms, four separate planted leg/foot contacts, two scissor blades forming one weapon, one blue flower. All spring, cap, limb and blade tips inside frame. Upper spring tip has a narrow but uncut margin.
visual_qa.method: Full image_gen result visually inspected. Saved PNG decoded with System.Drawing at 1536x1024 and SHA256 verified. Saved view_image call displayed a thin lavender strip despite valid PNG decoding; root should independently inspect the image.
visual_qa.limits: Single-view 2D concept candidate; not selected and not a validated 3D mesh or rig.
